result.brief: 提出自我中心视觉-语言-触觉基准 TouchBench，并用触觉统计文本提示（TaP）让 VLM 推理不可见物理属性，提升接触类问题准确率。
result.reason: Egocentric vision-language-tactile benchmark and tactile-as-text prompting for VLM physical reasoning; no video world model or visual representation contribution, only embodied perception evaluation.
